args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After the v2.3.1 deploy, checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), with an 18% error rate. The v2.3.1-rc build had also been unhealthy in staging. The service was rolled back in all regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, checkout-api reports healthy on v2.3.0 in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying, and review why a release that was unhealthy in staging was promoted to production.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, was failing health checks and had an 18% error rate.
- **Target version:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. v2.2.9 is older, and v2.3.1 was unhealthy in both staging (as v2.3.1-rc) and production.
- **Rollback:** all three regions now run v2.3.0. A follow-up status check shows the service healthy with a 0.2% error rate.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery. It also lists two follow-ups: find the root cause before redeploying v2.3.1, and review why a build that was unhealthy in staging was released to production.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
